avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing doxepin levels and efficacy; increases serotonergic effects
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort; allow 2-week washout before starting doxepin or vice versa

avoid_supplements.name: SAMe
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive serotonergic effects increasing risk of serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support supplements

avoid_supplements.name: 5-HTP
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive serotonergic activity elevating serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; consult provider before use

avoid_supplements.name: Tramadol
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP2D6 competition and serotonergic interaction increasing seizure and serotonin syndrome risk

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce doxepin levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor therapeutic response; adjust doxepin dose if needed

caution_supplements.name: Black Cohosh
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive CNS effects and anticholinergic properties
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for excessive sedation or anticholinergic symptoms

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive drowsiness; counsel on fall risk

avoid_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products, soy sauce)
avoid_foods.mechanism: TCAs inhibit monoamine oxidase; hypertensive crisis risk with high tyramine intake
avoid_foods.action: Restrict high-tyramine foods; educate on dietary limitations

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase doxepin plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Limit grapefruit consumption; monitor for increased anticholinergic or sedative effects

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: May potentiate CNS stimulation or antagonize sedative effects of doxepin
caution_foods.action: Moderate caffeine intake; counsel patient on timing relative to dose

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression, anticholinergic effects, and sedation
caution_foods.action: Advise minimal to no alcohol consumption; counsel on impaired cognition and fall risk

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, muscle rigidity) when combining with serotonergic agents. Assess for anticholinergic toxicity (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation, confusion) and CNS depression (excessive sedation, impaired coordination) especially in elderly patients on concurrent depressants.
